breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the flawed instruction: 'Assume the pure-bending normal stress is uniform over the section depth so that the stress at the neutral axis has the same sign as at the extreme fibers.' This directly mirrors the incorrect assumption from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth removes this erroneous instruction entirely, preserving the standard flexure formula behavior where stress varies linearly with depth and is zero at the neutral axis. The agent failed to remove this inconsistency.
